Primary idea of this project is to learn so every time the user prompts any of AI models to do something, it should be specified what should be done exactly since we want to avoid situation where a file gets generated and the user does not know what it is for.

Since this is a university project, we are using guidelines for project structue in form of lab files.
When user asks for you to get familiar with the latest lab file, you need to read it and understand the requirements following the current project structure and relation to lab files that are already implemented.
=> lab files are located: /docs/lab1/lab1.md, /docs/lab2/lab2.md, /docs/lab3/lab3.md, /docs/lab4/lab4.md, /docs/lab5/lab5.md

When user asks for a migration of any kind =>
use skill stored in /.github/skills/ef-migrations.md

For any kind of design requirement or creating a component that will end up in the front end of the user =>
use /.github/agents/DesignerAgent.agent.md

Idea of the applciation is described in the documentiation =>
docs/semantic-model.md
